resources.string: Tap a section card, or its icon in the toolbar, to open it. Use the globe icon to switch between American and British English. Tap the ? icon on any screen for help. Everything is organised into four sections.

Tap + to add a memory with a title, note, mood and date. Tap a memory to read it in full. Tap the bin icon to delete it; use Undo in the message at the bottom if you change your mind. Turn your phone sideways to see the list and details side by side.
Write an optional note, then tap Thinking of You, Miss You or Send a Hug. Your sent pings are listed below. Clear removes the history. Customise the note however you like.
Tap Set anniversary to choose the day you got together. The big number shows how many days you have been together, and the bar shows progress to the next 100-day milestone.
Tap + to plan a date with a place and day. Tick the box when you have done it. Tap a plan for details, or the bin icon to delete it.
